requirements.says: The compute dispatcher shall run a calculation on the CPU, the NPU or the GPU according to the calculation's kind and the machine's present conditions.
The compute dispatcher shall report the expected run time of a calculation before starting it and refuse a calculation whose expected run time exceeds its declared bound.
